review.headline: Tempo block ran at target pace, but the warm-up and cool-down were run at about 5:45/km, faster than the 5:11-6:13 easy band's midpoint and the session was 8 km total, so the structure was largely followed.
observations: Tempo km 3-6 averaged 4:36-4:37/km at HR 162, matching the 4:37/km threshold target almost exactly.
Warm-up and cool-down (2 km each) ran at 5:45/km with HR 135-140, which is within the easy band of 5:11-6:13/km.
Total 8.0 km in 2488 s at 5:11/km average, with consistent splits and no fade through the tempo block.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so perceived effort for the tempo block is unknown.
Weekly volume is far behind plan: 8.0 km of 42 km planned in week 1, with 6 of 7 sessions and all strength and cross-training missed.
CTL has dropped from 43.7 to 25.7 over the 3 weeks since this run, with no further training logged after 2026-11-03.
